authored_quests.scope: Unmodified condition trees with supplied actors, groups and controlled area geometry; trigger bodies and map initialization are not replayed.

attack.limits: Synthetic no-spread boundary cases. Does not cover damage, armour, backstab or RNG equivalence.
attack.scope: Original hit decision with zero random spread versus Combat.attack_hits.

attack_chance.limits: Compares the combat probability query for unaimed attacks. Does not test the remake RNG stream.
attack_chance.scope: Enumerate all supplied native roll residues versus Combat.hit_chance.

body_health.limits: Six supplied part records; no damage absorption, equipment, visuals, death dispatch or regeneration scheduling.
body_health.scope: Native aggregate HP, healing and HP rescaling versus GameUnit body methods after each operation.

cast_rank.limits: Does not cover target acquisition, line of sight, spell application or damage. This terrain fixture requires one ground height per XY coordinate.
cast_rank.scope: Original candidate-selection loop versus Spells._cast_pick, including dead-node removal.

clock.limits: No world simulation, input handling, rendering or worker debt retention is covered.
clock.scope: Original raw timestamp loop versus GameWorld._sample_frame; simulation bodies are counters.

darkness.limits: Does not test rendered daylight, weather changes or the clock's progression.
darkness.scope: Original simulation darkness versus GameWorld.darkness at clock boundaries.

effect_lifetime.limits: One feeblemind counter; no application, stacking, client presentation, serialization or other effect modifiers.
effect_lifetime.scope: Native signed-counter decrement/keep result versus authoritative GameUnit._tick_effects membership.

eye_height.limits: Normal grounded figures only; no flying eye approximation or occlusion query.
eye_height.scope: Original normal-figure eye position versus GameUnit.eye_z.

faction_relation.limits: Matrix updates only; individual hate, taming and notification side effects are separate regressions.
faction_relation.scope: Original directional faction-bit updates versus GameWorld.set_relation.

interaction_reach.limits: Does not cover route planning, inventory transfer or actual lever use.
interaction_reach.scope: Original type-6 interaction distance versus ScriptVM._interact_reach.

noticed_retention.limits: Already noticed living targets only. Does not establish initial acquisition, pathing, corpse handling or full combat execution.
noticed_retention.scope: Original living-target retention branch in 5caa00 versus the production UnitAI.player_perceive drop pass.

path_refine.limits: Refines supplied routes; does not establish whole-route search or collision/spline equivalence. Heading is a supplied direction code.
path_refine.scope: Original turn-template builder and local path-refinement pass versus NavTurn.refine.
stubs: supplied navigation costs, slopes and occupancy

quest_predicate.limits: Bounded expressions and ASCII keys/strings only; no quest rewards, carried inventory or transfers, script scheduler or campaign completion.
quest_predicate.scope: Native numeric quest expressions, nested calls, group quantifiers and constructed areas versus ScriptVM._eval.
stubs: preallocated area containers, including empty missing IDs
supplied world time, player-zero purse and quest-item bag

quest_program.limits: One already-started body, not native thread-list scheduling, spawning, save serialization, reward delivery or a complete campaign.
quest_program.scope: Persistent native command dispatcher versus ScriptVM._run at consecutive 55 ms logic ticks: numeric global assignments, Sleep, SleepUntil and KillScript.
stubs: supplied initial globals and external per-tick changes
temporary command cleanup (no temporary values in fixture)

quest_trigger.limits: Repeated independent condition polls; no sleep scheduling, one-shot disposal, quest rewards or full campaign playthrough.
quest_trigger.scope: Native ordered condition-list gate versus ScriptVM._run at supplied polls, recording body dispatch.
stubs: preallocated area containers, including empty missing IDs
supplied world time, player-zero purse and quest-item bag
trigger body dispatch recorded as an event

script_random.limits: Tests the mapping, not the RNG generator or whole-game random draw order.
script_random.scope: Original Random opcode with supplied uint32 words versus ScriptVM.random_value.

sight_factor.limits: Does not establish complete stealth, terrain occlusion or AI behavior.
sight_factor.scope: Original observer sight multiplier versus GameUnit.sight_factor.

village_gate.limits: Tests eligibility for all command-code pairs, not command dispatch or dialogue content.
village_gate.scope: Original village-talk eligibility branch versus GameUnit.village_talk_ready.

reference.description: Locally verified GOG base-game game.exe. Addresses are valid only for this digest.
